title: tc-sparkline
description:
A small inline trend chart – line, area, bars or win-loss – sized from the text around it, with optional markers, a
reference line, a tone for which way it went and, when interactive, a tooltip per point.

values.description: The values, oldest first; null is a gap

labels.description: A label per value, e.g. dates – read in the tooltip and announcements

label.description: What it measures, e.g. "Samples per day" – starts the accessible summary; by default "Trend"

min.description: The bottom of the scale; by default the lowest value (0 for bars)

max.description: The top of the scale; by default the highest value

reference.description: A value to draw as a dashed line, e.g. a target

referenceLabel.description: What the reference line is, for the summary

markers.description: Points to mark, space-separated: any of "last", "first", "min", "max"; "none" for none

good.description: Which way is good: "up" or "down"; with tone "auto", it's green when it moved that way and red when it didn't

tone.description: The colour: "auto" follows `good` (neutral without it), or a fixed tone

height.description: Height in px; by default 1.25em, so it matches the text

interactive.description: One tab stop: the arrow keys step through the points with a tooltip

unit.description: What the values count, after the number: "148 samples"

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's
